units.source_text: 柏木非常高兴地接受了我的赠礼。

en.t: Kashiwagi accepted my gift with great delight.

units.source_text: 他还到房东太太那里借来了插花用的水盘和在水里剪花茎和校用的白铁桶等。

en.t: He also borrowed from the landlady a basin for flower arrangement, a white tin bucket for cutting and adjusting flower stems in water, and other such things.

units.source_text: 这家是平房，他住在四铺席的厢房里。

en.t: The house was a single-story building, and he lived in a four-mat side room.
